name: sdd-converge
description: SDD step 4b. Decides whether a feature is done by judging every acceptance criterion against the code and tests in the working tree, never against summaries or checkboxes. Appends the missing work to plan.md as a Convergence section, or leaves plan.md byte-identical and returns CONVERGED. Run as an independent verifier subagent after /sdd-implement, and repeat implement and converge until CONVERGED.
